record_scope_reconstruction: February 7, 2020 protest on the North Channel road bridge in the Seaway system between Cornwall and Cornwall Island, inside Canada. Reported authority closure extended to non-emergency north/south bridge-system traffic. Do not collapse this to the South Channel international boundary span or the Thousand Islands protest reported separately later in February.

Full WWNY report inspected: February 7 Seaway event distinguished from February 17 Thousand Islands action.

Direct OSM XML inspected: active North Channel road bridge, separate parallel sidewalk, mainland Canadian toll/customs and abandoned western rail bridge. sha256 016212a7eadae5e45cdfe892fe07fddd70ceb785f9f97edd77bded90ae9b9f1f.
